claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi_mechanics_magic_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines passive always-on benefits with a separate once-per-dawn activated spell property. MagicItemMechanics currently allows only one mechanics family, so no single existing family can represent the full item honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing it, you gain the following benefits. ... Web. You can cast Web ... Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access_overrides
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The granted Web cast needs item-specific overrides that the current grant_spell_access shape cannot express: a fixed save DC and a modified area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Web. You can cast Web (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ignore_web_restrictions
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak grants deterministic immunity / traversal behavior for webs that is not represented by grant_speed, condition immunity, or any current terrain-related atom in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Spider Walk. You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.
